instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all buttons, interactive items, inputs, and modals contain 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='whatsapp-checkout-btn', data-testid='product-card-lum-01').
Ensure zero-API WhatsApp checkout opens wa.me/919112299902 with pre-filled encoded shopping bag summary and total price.
Persist cart items and wishlist state seamlessly in localStorage.
Use framer-motion for smooth entrance animations and micro-interactions on mobile swipe, card tap, and bottom-sheet expansion.
Do not use transparent background on header, sticky bottom bar or modals; always use backdrop-blur glassmorphism with white opacity.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_requirement: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.mobile_first: Prioritize viewport widths 375px to 430px, maintaining crisp 2-column grid and smooth touch interactions
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_header: Header and overlays must have backdrop-blur and semi-opaque background for high contrast legibility
